notes.title: Practical Skills
notes.content: If you find the handle trigger inconvenient to use, you can try to put the keyboard on the ground and play with your foot on the space bar and Num0 key. It may be rude, but it feels good.

notes.title: Open the menu!
notes.content:
Change to a long press to open the menu.
Now press 1.5s to open the menu.
